name: Salmon Recovery and Puget Sound Acquisition and Restoration grants

funder.name: Washington Recreation and Conservation Office (Salmon Recovery Funding Board)

summary: Annual Washington State grants to restore degraded salmon habitat and protect high-quality habitat, open to nonprofits, regional fisheries enhancement groups, tribes and others, ranked through local lead entities.

amount.note: Applicants may request any amount above $5,000; design-only projects without match are capped at $350,000
